status: exploratory synthesis after fixed falsification hierarchy; not submission authority
one_sentence: Recent rain does not merely amplify the existing chorus; it selectively re-expresses historically used species x site acoustic templates, and the realized spatial depth of those reactivated species is sufficient to generate the observed boundary-biased matrix expansion.

evidence: CallingIndex total rainfall slope is dominated by 0-to-positive activation rather than shared-cell intensification.
87.1% of the activation slope is carried by cells entering at CI2-3.
CI3 full-chorus recruitment is positive in all pairs and in the same-observer + same-physical-site subset.
The effect survives measured hearing/noise/wind adjustment and protocol-window sensitivity.
Wet-side strong chorus is preferentially placed at SiteIDs where the same species had previously formed a strong chorus.
The effect persists after opportunity normalization, within pair x species, after controlling generic other-species site quality, and after controlling neighborhood distance.
Rain-selective memory bootstrap shows the memory-targeting coefficient is larger for wet-side recruitment than the symmetric dry-side target.
19/20 estimable species have positive own-site template coefficients.
Most rainfall-associated route-new incidence is recurrence of taxa observed in other years of the same route-season stratum.
Using strictly earlier years only, strong CI2-3 recruitment is still almost entirely recurrent; the no-prior-record component has near-zero rainfall coefficient.
CI3 full-chorus recruitment is likewise overwhelmingly recurrent.

memory_duration.reason: Prespecified old-memory gate failed because only 136 routes contained the required within-species old-memory versus no-memory contrast (gate required >=200 routes).
memory_duration.interpretation: The data strongly suggest a multi-year decaying local template, including reactivation after intervening sampled silence, but the prefixed route-count gates prevent elevating this to a formally classified result.

evidence: The excess is not mainly more route-new species.
The number reaching a second stop is not exceptional.
Third-and-later-stop incidence is strongly excessive under both primary null families, with fourth-and-later-stop incidence also excessive.
Conditional on occupied-stop count k, unusual geographic placement is not required.
Among route-new species, historical strong-chorus breadth predicts wet-side stop depth.
Rain contrast positively interacts with historical breadth in the post-activation depth model.
limitations: Same-observer and exact-consecutive-year versions failed their prefixed coverage gates.
This model is conditional on activation and does not predict which species activates.

uniform_shift.meaning: A common increase in acoustic activation cannot reproduce observed allocation.

persistence_preserving_shift.meaning: Strong preservation of dry-side species x stop identity is insufficient.

crossfit_species_shift.meaning: Transferable species-specific rainfall sensitivity alone is insufficient.

prior_local_memory_weighted.meaning: Historical species x site recurrence describes where activity tends to recur but is not sufficient by itself to generate the full matrix geometry.

crossfit_rain_x_local_memory_single_gate.meaning: A single cross-fit rain-by-memory gating parameter is still insufficient.

species_identity_plus_realized_wet_k.meaning: Once which species activate and each activated species' realized wet-side occupied-stop count are fixed, special stop placement is not required. The mechanistic bottleneck is activation depth, not geometry conditional on depth.

within_naamp.interpretation: Pooled regional robustness is strong, but state-level effect heterogeneity is substantial.

across_species.interpretation: The local-template effect is taxonomically broad among estimable NAAMP taxa.

cross_continent.reason: Available external datasets do not provide an effort-complete multi-location species x site matrix comparable with NAAMP; AnuraSet site tests do not meet the prefixed threshold-dominance replication rule.

mechanistic_ceiling.best_supported_statement: Recent rain acts as a temporal gate on a persistent, species-specific local acoustic template. Rain-associated recruitment is predominantly re-expression of previously used species x site combinations, often reaching overlapping or full chorus, and the key matrix-level degree of freedom is how deeply each recruited species expands across stops.
mechanistic_ceiling.unresolved_choice: Persistent local populations versus persistent species-specific microhabitat suitability cannot be separated with these acoustic observations alone.

stop_rule: No additional post-readback NAAMP mechanism model should be added unless it tests a qualitatively new falsifiable alternative. The next scientifically valuable step is an independent effort-complete external replication or direct hydrological/individual-level data.
